description:
Facing a chance to eliminate Vegas on the road in Game 5, Kasperi Kapanen delivered in dramatic fashion, scoring the lone goal in overtime to send Edmonton to the Western Conference Final.  The decisive moment came off a Darnell Nurse point shot that created chaos in front of the net. Kapanen battled relentlessly for the loose puck, outworking defenders and finally burying it after multiple attempts, sealing the series for the Oilers.

description:
Facing a formidable Dallas Stars squad in the Western Conference Final, Stuart Skinner delivered a masterful performance between the pipes for the Edmonton Oilers. Across the series, he recorded an impressive .924 save percentage, a 2.01 GAA, and one shutout, helping the Oilers eliminate the Stars in just five games.  
In the third period of Game 5. With Dallas pressing hard, a point shot made its way through heavy traffic, and Skinner made the initial save. The rebound landed on the stick of Colin Blackwell, alone in front with a golden opportunity. Blackwell fired quickly toward what seemed like a sure goal, but Skinner stretched out and deflected the puck with the toe of his skate, preserving Edmonton’s two-goal lead and solidifying his role as a driving force behind the series victory.

In hockey, it’s often said that the toughest game to win is the one that ends a series. Facing the Devils in the 2025 Stanley Cup Playoffs, Sebastian Aho rose to the occasion, scoring the series-clinching goal in double overtime of Game 5. The goal was his second of the night, capping off a stellar three-point performance and sending his team to the next round.

description:
With their season on the line in Game 7, Cole Perfetti and the Jets fought desperately to stay alive. Already on the scoresheet earlier in the game, Perfetti delivered in dramatic fashion, scoring with just three seconds left in regulation—the latest game-tying goal in a Game 7 in NHL history.

description:
In a crucial Game 4 on home ice, with a chance to seize a 3-1 series lead, Mikael Granlund stole the show, scoring all three goals in the Stars’ 3-1 victory over the Jets.  
Granlund opened the scoring on a first-period power play, receiving a drop pass deep in his own zone before charging up the ice. Gaining speed, he unleashed a precise shot from the top of the circles, beating Connor Hellebuyck to light the lamp.  
Late in the second period, with the game knotted at 1-1, Granlund broke loose on a 2-on-1 rush. Opting to shoot, he rifled the puck top shelf, over Hellebuyck’s glove, to restore the Stars’ lead.  
In the third period, Granlund completed his hat trick on another power play. Positioned at a sharp angle, he hammered a one-timer past the Jets’ netminder, sealing the win.  
Granlund’s first career playoff hat trick proved to be the decisive edge, pushing Dallas closer to the Western Conference Final.

description:
Charging hard on the forecheck, Brad Marchand beats out the icing call and keeps the play alive. As the puck battle ensues, Eetu Luostarinen joins the fray, wrestles control, and dishes it back to Marchand. With a sharp eye, Marchand finds Anton Lundell wide open in front of the net. Lundell takes the pass, shifts to his forehand, and fires the puck past the goalie before he can react, securing the opening goal of Game 4. Lundell’s goal, along with a key assist later in the game, powered Florida to a crucial victory and a commanding 3-1 series lead over Tampa Bay in the Battle of Florida.  
In the 2025 Stanley Cup Playoffs, Anton Lundell led all players with a +19 plus/minus, playing a crucial role in helping the Panthers secure their second straight Stanley Cup championship.

description:
In a thrilling Game 7 against the team where he spent part of his first ten seasons in the League, Mikko Rantanen delivered a performance for the ages. Now suiting up for Dallas, Rantanen turned a two-goal third-period deficit into history, becoming the first player ever to score a third-period hat trick in a Game 7. 
His first goal electrified the home crowd, a pinpoint wrist shot that clanged off the crossbar and in, igniting Dallas's comeback. Just a few shifts later, Rantanen weaved through three Colorado defenders for a stunning wraparound goal to tie the game. With the momentum firmly in Dallas's favor, Rantanen assisted on Wyatt Johnston's game-winning tally before sealing the victory himself with an empty-net goal, capping a four-point night and an unforgettable display of clutch brilliance.

This set showcases the intense battles, dramatic goals, and game-changing plays that defined the quest for hockey's ultimate prize. Relive the passion and excitement as teams fought tirelessly to keep their championship dreams alive.

description:
Charging down the middle of the ice, Dylan Strome took a crisp feed from Anthony Beauvillier and wasted no time redirecting it on goal. Though the initial shot was turned aside, Strome stayed with the play, quickly tapping the rebound in on his backhand for the eventual game-winning goal. Building on a career-high 82-point regular season that led the team, Strome carried his momentum into the playoffs, notching nine points in the First Round—once again pacing all Capitals players.
